name: TLL Language Semantics Truth
description: Canonical language semantics truth for TLL. Defines what the language supports, with evidence and confidence levels.

language_features.description: Variable declaration with let (mutable) and const (immutable).
First-class functions with parameters and return values.
Functions that capture variables from their enclosing scope.
Cooperative multitasking with create, yield, resume, sleep.
language_features.benchmark: 100K immediate-return coroutines: 95.4us each; 100K yield: 2.19us each; 1K sleep: 0.111ms each

language_features.description: Structured data types with named fields.
JSON parse and stringify for objects, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans.
TCP client and server sockets with non-blocking IO and select.
language_features.known_limitation: FD_SETSIZE=64, maximum 64 concurrent file descriptors. This is a design limit, not a bug. Exceeding 64 results in silent ignore of additional fds (no crash).

language_features.description: Peer-to-peer networking with message framing, broadcast, connect, disconnect, reconnect.
Import and export between TLL files.

scope_model.description: TLL uses function-level scope. if/while/for blocks do NOT create new lexical scope. Variables declared in blocks are hoisted to function level.
scope_model.note: This is a deliberate language design choice, documented in SCOPE_SEMANTICS.md. Future versions may add block scope, but current version is function-level only.

known_limitations.description: TLL int is 32-bit. 64-bit operations require simulation (high32 + low32). This affects SHA-512 and Ed25519 pure-TLL implementation.
known_limitations.planned_fix: P0-15.19 will add C-native Ed25519 and SHA-512 to avoid pure-TLL 64-bit simulation.

known_limitations.description: Current blockchain uses HMAC-SHA256 as SIMULATED signature. Not real Ed25519/secp256k1.
known_limitations.planned_fix: P0-15.19 TLL Cryptographic Foundation will add Ed25519.

known_limitations.description: No crypto.randomBytes() for key generation, tokens, agent IDs.
known_limitations.planned_fix: P0-15.19 will add C-native secure random (Linux: getrandom, Windows: BCryptGenRandom, macOS: /dev/urandom).
